summary: Architectural elegance meets timeless design with our sophisticated range of Soft Square style Basins, Toilets and Baths. Discover a cohesive experience tailored to the design conscious individual.
title: New Soft Square Collection
bodyHtml:
Architectural Elegance, Timeless Design

Refined Aesthetic

Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, Studio Bagno's range of Soft Square style basins, baths, and toilets combines timeless geometry with graceful curves to bring a touch of refined luxury to your bathroom space.

Discover the Soft Square Collection

A Cohesive Bathware Experience

Every piece of Studio Bagno's Soft Square range is designed to complement each other effortlessly. Whether you're seeking a statement basin to serve as the centerpiece of your wash area or a sleek toilet that embodies both style and functionality, our range caters to the design-conscious individual.

Contemporary & Sophisticated

Characterized by clean lines, subtle curves, and precise angles, our soft square bathware exudes a luxurious contemporary style that seamlessly integrates into any modern bathroom space.

Explore the Range

Explore the complete Soft Square range on our website today and discover the perfect pieces to elevate your space.

Click the button below to learn more or call us at (02) 9601 1948 to organize a viewing.

Discover the Soft Square Collection

Download our complete 2024 Collection Catalogue

This edition of our catalog marks a significant shift in how we present our products. Discover thoughtfully curated sets that bring together essential bathroom components—basins, toilets, baths, and in-wall cisterns.

Plus explore an expansive range of New Baths, New Matte White Collection, a swathe of brand new product lines, a return of pricing and so much more!
